text:
Situation: Cisplatin has been on FDA's drug shortage list since 2023-02-10 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a period of 44 months. Corvale East holds 166 total units across three presentations at a burn rate of 9.3 units per day, providing 18 days of supply. Corvale General holds 270 total units across three lots at 8.7 units per day, providing 31 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA posted the cisplatin shortage on 2023-02-10. An inspection of Thymoorgan Pharmazie GmbH (FEI 3002320821), the registered plant for the Hikma label (NDC 00143950401), ended on 2022-10-06 with a VAI classification. A subsequent inspection of the same plant ended on 2023-04-25, also classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2023-07-10.

Our position: Current inventory covers 18 to 31 days depending on site. The rule-based best option is Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose plant was last inspected VAI on 2023-08-24.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Sagent Pharmaceuticals as secondary source; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate WG Critical Care, LLC stock availability; requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to monitor Accord Healthcare Inc. supply status given plant OAI classification 2022-12-02; requires P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to request manufacturing site disclosure from Apotex Corp.; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or protocol substitutions at this time.
